news.title: DOJ Creates 'Super Intelligence' Task Force to Guard Against AI Abuse
news.summary: Led by two senior DOJ officials, the Super Intelligence Task Force will target misuse by foreign governments, criminal groups and fraudsters—while pushing AI developers to tighten internal controls so their systems “behave as intended.”

news.title: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
news.summary: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.

news.title: Zcash Upgrade Could Lock $16 Million in Crypto Forever
news.summary: Zcash's latest upgrade promises faster transactions, but thousands of coins remain in an aging privacy system that will soon stop accepting withdrawals, potentially leaving their owners empty-handed.

news.title: OpenAI Found 948 Linux Security Flaws—And Figured Out How to Exploit Them
news.summary: An automated OpenAI system produced working exploits and draft fixes at roughly $1,279 per flaw, raising new questions about how cheaply AI can find holes in critical software at scale.

news.title: Binance, Deribit revoke SignalPlus API keys after fake Teams invite attack
news.summary: SignalPlus said attackers compromised an engineer’s computer in a breach that resulted in losses of less than $82,000, which the crypto trading platform pledged to reimburse in full.

news.title: Base主网上线Denim升级，出块时间缩短至200毫秒
news.summary: 【Base主网上线Denim升级，出块时间缩短至200毫秒】金色财经报道，11月6日，Base在X平台发帖称，Denim升级已在主网正式上线，网络实现原生200毫秒出块，即每秒产出5个完整区块。Denim以原生区块取代此前的Flashblocks预确认，每个区块均有独立的区块号、哈希、状态根和收据。此次升级还引入BaseTime，使合约可实现毫秒级时间精度（block.timestamp仍以秒为单位），并改进B20代币标准，发行方可要求每笔转账经由转账代理等指定方审批，并可将同一地址列表用作白名单或黑名单。

news.title: CFTC允许衍生品清算机构通过信托公司进行日常结算
news.summary:
【CFTC允许衍生品清算机构通过信托公司进行日常结算】金色财经报道，11月6日，据美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）官方声明，CFTC清算和风险部门发布一封不采取行动函，明确衍生品清算机构（DCO）可以使用信托公司与清算成员进行日常结算，前提是须按照CFTC的适用要求，将相关信托公司视同结算银行对待。

原文链接: https://www.cftc.gov/PressRoom/PressReleases/9322-26
